## [1.9.3](https://github.com/pengusto/penguin-patches/compare/v1.9.2...v1.9.3) (2026-11-10)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* avoid redundant bot PR preflight ([494d323](https://github.com/pengusto/penguin-patches/commit/494d323a54e80a97c2563d63f7fb10523ed24bb7))
* **calendar:** support readable descriptions on 1.12.2 ([#80](https://github.com/pengusto/penguin-patches/issues/80)) ([556cf1e](https://github.com/pengusto/penguin-patches/commit/556cf1e8b97cef7b82db40f1d77a084688a6a93c))
* simplify Finamp patch maintenance ([597fc81](https://github.com/pengusto/penguin-patches/commit/597fc814c5ca22bf2355dcaa52179145eb6424f0))

patches.name: Keep local manga in exclusion searches
patches.description: Keep local manga when an excluded search term does not match. Matching titles, tags and remote source IDs are still excluded. Official GitHub Komikku 1.14.1 ARM64 APK tested.

patches.name: Preserve excluded Default-category downloads
patches.description: Keep read chapter downloads when Default is excluded from deletion. Corrects the Default category's numeric ID without changing other deletion preferences. Official GitHub Mihon 0.21.3 ARM64 APK tested.

patches.name: Zoom article images
patches.description: Open article images in a separate viewer with pinch, pan, double-tap and accessible zoom controls. Linked images offer View image or Open link. Uses Feeder's existing image loader and network policy. Official project F-Droid APK 2.25.0 only.

patches.name: Finamp Complete
patches.description: Apply all available Penguin Finamp fixes together. Requires the original official Finamp 1.0.1 APK; produces ARM64-only output.

patches.name: Restore widget editing from the search menu
patches.description: Open the existing widget editor from the search bar menu when the Edit button is hidden, without changing the preference or stored widgets.

patches.name: Import nested OPML feeds
patches.description: Import feeds inside nested OPML folders into their outer group, preserving document order and feed settings. Official GitHub Read You 0.16.2 APK only.

patches.name: Configure custom OAuth for Infinity+
patches.description: Use a configured Reddit OAuth client consistently through login and token exchange in Infinity+ 8.3.4, without the app subscription gate.

options.description: Public Reddit installed-app client ID you are authorized to use. Never enter a password, client secret or login token.
Exact custom-scheme redirect registered for this OAuth client. No shared-client default.
Identifying user agent for the configured client; nonempty printable ASCII.

patches.name: Readable Calendar descriptions
patches.description: Readable event descriptions in the editor, lists, widget and reminders; preserves the original editor text.

patches.name: Separate all-day reminder defaults
patches.description: Choose three separate default reminders for new all-day events in Calendar settings. Keeps timed-event defaults, existing events and the use-last-reminders setting.

patches.name: Choose upcoming alarm notification time
patches.description: Choose the advance notice in Morphe, with separate notifications and skip actions for each alarm occurrence. Keeps native ringing times and alarm definitions.

options.description: Minutes before each alarm, from 1 to 1440. Chosen when patching; patch the original APK again to change it.

patches.name: Show emails and notes from merged contacts
patches.description: Include duplicate contact emails and notes in the detail view without changing stored contact records.

patches.name: Keep favorites consistent after folder rename or removal
patches.description: Update nested favorite paths after successful single or multiple renames and remove nested favorites with their deleted parent.

patches.name: Avoid notifications for visible conversations
patches.description: Check visible conversation on the main thread before posting an incoming-message notification.

patches.name: Dismiss notifications when marking conversations read
patches.description: Remove the selected conversation's notification after Mark as read in the conversation list.

patches.name: Keep background conversations unread
patches.description: Do not mark incoming messages read when their conversation is left in the background.

patches.name: Prefer each track's embedded cover
patches.description: Use file-specific cover artwork before shared album art, retaining the original fallback and worker callback.

patches.name: Navigate to the parent task
patches.description: Add a parent-task arrow to the existing editor. Keeps Back behavior and the current filter; asks whether to save, discard or cancel when the draft has changes. Official project F-Droid APK 15.13 only.
